title: Control Measures

blocks.title: Control Measures
blocks.body:
# Control Measures — colors and codes

TacMap **Tools → Control Measures** places MIL-STD-2525C Appendix B tactical graphics as point markers. Each marker is a chip with a short code. The code color tells the graphic's job.

The name under the marker stays white. The first checkpoint is `CP1`, the next is `CP2`, and so on.

Search matches the code, the name, or the symbol identity code (SIDC). The list opens on the first page and loads more as you scroll.

`CASEVAC` uses the same symbol as `MEDEVAC`.

These graphics are places and tasks. They are not friendly or enemy unit icons. A soldier or enemy person is a unit symbol (rectangle or diamond), which is not in this list.

Source in the app: `MilStd2525cControlMeasures.kt` (`MilStd2525cColors.markerInk`).

---

## How the color is chosen

The app checks the symbol in this order.

1. **Fixed symbols**
   - Chemical and other CBRN graphics use a **yellow** chip and a **black** code.
   - A blue kill box stays **blue**. A purple kill box stays **purple**.
   - Medical points are **maroon**: MEDEVAC, casualty collection (`CCP`), and the ambulance exchange point (`AEP`).
2. **Section**, for every other symbol.
   - **Blue** — maneuver.
   - **Red** — fires and weapon points. A target reference point (`TRP`) is red because it is a fires reference.
   - **Green** — obstacles, bypass and crossing, survivability, and deception.
   - **Black** — boundaries, phase lines, sustainment, hazards, and other reference graphics.
3. An objective (`OBJ`) is **blue** because it sits with offense. A fire-support target (`TGT`) is **red**.

On the map the code is the dark color on a light chip. In the picker the same role uses a lighter shade so it stays readable on the dark list.

| Color | Meaning | Examples |
|-------|---------|----------|
| Blue | Maneuver | Check point, start point, rally point, objective, assembly area, battle position, routes, tasks |
| Red | Fires | Fire support coordination line, target, firing point, target reference point, weapon points |
| Green | Obstacles and engineer work | Minefield, wire, bridge, ford, survivability, deception |
| Maroon | Medical | MEDEVAC, casualty collection point, ambulance exchange point |
| Yellow chip, black code | CBRN | Chemical contaminated area, chemical release, biological area, decon point |
| Blue kill box | Blue kill box | Circular, irregular, or rectangular blue kill box |
| Purple kill box | Purple kill box | Circular, irregular, or rectangular purple kill box |
| Black | Boundaries, sustainment, reference | Phase line, boundary, FLOT, supply point, hazard, fix |

---
